posts.author: spades141
posts.body: So im playing d&d with the kids and been wanting to mess with rpg maker for sometime now. I've had it for atleast 5 years and messed with it a few times. So my game starting off is that I have a party of 3 traveling with wagons on their way to the starter town. I want a dragon to attack the wagons and kill almost everyone in the wagons except the party. Im not sure how to go about doing that. Any help or videos I can watch that will help me with this.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Search for a flying dragon sprite and wagon sprite, make the dragon move on a map where you see the wagons also moving, use an animation for the dragon fire. Also play some fire animation on top of the wagons. Use move routes to make NPCs jump out of the wagons (turn page 2 graphic on with a switch) and then play fire animations on them and change their graphics to downed ones. And play screaming BGS.
